analysis_revision.policy: Only the analysis consumer file may differ with explicit opt-in; every producer source hash and frozen analysis criterion remains exact. Frozen plans and saved science are never rewritten.

count_scope: Group accepted/rejected counts partition every nonzero pulse group; primary outcome sets can overlap when a primary has multiple groups. Zeros remain in initial denominators only.

bootstrap.method: primary-cluster Poisson(1) event bootstrap preserving all pulse groups and cone hypotheses
bootstrap.scope: finite-sample peak variation only; no model, calibration or hardware uncertainty

criteria.isotope_window_selection_rule: apply every window to every source using observed fixed-gain readout energy; retain cross-isotope contributions
criteria.mixture_rule: equal initial source yields: 0.5*map_a/N_a + 0.5*map_b/N_b; no unit-area source renormalization
criteria.peak_rule: 8-neighbor local maxima; equal plateaus merged; highest first, then highest outside fixed separation
criteria.representative_rule: first accepted unambiguous pulse group per source component in original ID order; otherwise first accepted; all 34 channels by hash/reference
criteria.truth_rule: detect peaks without truth, then minimum-total-distance one-to-one matching
criteria.valley_rule: minimum bilinear score on the interior short great-circle or plane segment; samples at quarter-bin spacing

failure_record_policy: Exact saved native error strings are counted without normalization in native_error_counts. Original errors and unknown null channel/readout fields remain in the sealed scalar Store, addressed by unchanged primary and pulse-group IDs; no zero waveform is generated.

co60-right.line_denominator_policy: Each window retains the full source-group initial denominator. No claim of photons emitted in that line; unknown energies are unassigned.

representative.selection_rule: first accepted unambiguous pulse group in original ID order; otherwise first accepted
representative.trace_policy: References only. Recover native Float64 arrays and replay frozen readout; verify the stored trace hashes.

limitations: Nominal cryostat and simulated pixel timing calibration; no experimental localization, range, activity or efficiency validation.
5-degree kernel and 15-degree/15-mm truth-matching tolerances are fixed engineering analysis settings, not measured detector resolution.
The z=40 mm plane is assumed; direction maps neglect vertex offset and are a far-field diagnostic at these nearby sources.
Line membership uses fixed-gain readout energy only. Unknown failed/rejected energies are not assigned to isotope windows.
Every isotope contributes to every observed-energy window when selected; source labels never remove continuum contamination.
All candidate cones are preserved with equal weights per accepted pulse group; source truth never chooses a candidate.
For an explicit source recovery, preserved groups keep their original wrapper/readout recipe hashes; exact event metadata selects the bound prior recipe.
Mixtures combine independent equal-initial-source yields without inter-source pileup; photon and isotope-decay denominators remain separate.

cs137-left__co60-right.independence: Independent source data, linearly combined; no inter-source pileup, coincidence or activity model.
cs137-left__co60-right.normalization: equal initial source yields: 0.5*map_a/N_a + 0.5*map_b/N_b; no unit-area source renormalization

gamma-left__gamma-right.independence: Independent source data, linearly combined; no inter-source pileup, coincidence or activity model.
gamma-left__gamma-right.normalization: equal initial source yields: 0.5*map_a/N_a + 0.5*map_b/N_b; no unit-area source renormalization

stage_accounting_policy: exclusive_stage_counts partitions pulse groups by the first unsuccessful stage or imaging acceptance. Existing readout/imaging rejection totals and reasons include upstream native failures and flags; they are not independent electronics failures. Initial zeros remain in denominators only.
validation_scope: Frozen plan, DONE identities, full Store/response hashes and sealed scalar completion; raw radiation archives are not decompressed or rescanned.
